role: prospective synthetic-only verification of fixed-score meter intervals
scores: ES uses Euclidean/sqrt24; VS uses p=.5 and normalized inverse-lag weights for all h<k
ensemble_coupling: Each condition uses shared IID standard-normal members for A and B; each marginal ensemble is IID. Weak/strong scenarios share the same ensembles.
rng: Ensembles: SeedSequence([ensemble_seed,refresh_index,condition]); refresh_index=0 for fixed ensembles, cohort_index+1 for refreshed ensembles. Meter effects: SeedSequence([cohort_seed,cohort_index,0]); daily noise: SeedSequence([cohort_seed,cohort_index,1]); bootstrap seed: SeedSequence([bootstrap_seed,cohort_index]).generate_state(1)[0]. All use NumPy default_rng.

scenarios.description: Normal meter effect, rho=.05; same condition marginals and fixed ensembles as strong_normal.
Normal meter effect, rho=.8; same condition marginals and fixed ensembles as weak_normal.
Centered unit-variance two-normal-mixture meter effect; rho=.6; non-Gaussian marginal shape.
Strong normal clustering and nearby predictive distributions; shared normal ensemble members preserve the small paired difference.

generation_omission.description: Separate Gaussian DGP demonstration: M8 ensembles refreshed each cohort, meter-only intervals compared with both conditional finite-ensemble and underlying generator-law targets. Conditional-target coverage is averaged over regenerated ensembles; it does not establish coverage for each individual ensemble.

identical_function_check: An A-minus-A zero column enters the same core bootstrap; expected degenerate status and no interval are reported separately, with coverage undefined.
reporting: All scenarios/cohorts retained. Report bias and its Monte Carlo SE; interval availability; coverage among available intervals with Wilson interval and MCSE; joint availability-and-coverage rate over all cohorts; widths; failure statuses. No nominal-coverage pass/fail threshold.
scope: Synthetic independent-meter verification only; finite fixed-ensemble targets. Does not establish coverage on reused/postselection Fluvius validation, under future weather, or for M1024 underlying generator-law inference.
